## Key points {.unnumbered}

- A list can hold elements of different types without coercing them to one type.
- Use `[[` to extract an element and `[` to keep a selection as a list.
- Name list elements to access them with `$`.
- Use `as.list()` to create a list and `unlist()` to flatten one into a vector.
